confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Cape Town price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is less certain. Accommodation reflects July winter pricing with a mid-year school-holiday uplift. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to local beer prices because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from an RBA homepage snippet returned by search (4pm, 15 October 2026); the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southern African tourist cities with comparable hospitality prices, priced above Johannesburg and in line with other mid-tier South African coastal tourist destinations. Accommodation uses July low-season winter rates in the central and Atlantic-seaboard visitor areas, including VAT.
